name: Tencent Meeting
description: Connect Tencent Meeting to manage meetings, recordings, transcripts, and reports.
authorization.title: Tencent Meeting authorization required
authorization.description: An administrator must first configure a Tencent Meeting third-party app. The official authorization page will return to Poco after authorization succeeds.
capabilities.title: Capabilities
capabilities.meetings.title: Meeting management
capabilities.meetings.description: Create, query, update meetings, and manage invitees.
capabilities.records.title: Recordings and transcripts
capabilities.records.description: Query recordings, download addresses, smart minutes, and transcripts.
capabilities.reports.title: Meeting reports
capabilities.control.title: In-meeting controls
capabilities.control.description: Call users into a meeting or remove current participants after confirmation.
configuration.corpId.label: Enterprise ID
configuration.corpId.description: Enterprise ID of the Tencent Meeting third-party app owner.
configuration.sdkId.label: App ID
configuration.sdkId.description: App ID (SDK ID) of the Tencent Meeting third-party app.
configuration.secret.label: Client secret
configuration.secret.description: Client secret of the Tencent Meeting third-party app, stored encrypted by Poco.
